name: show_generations
description: Browse past completed non-Marketing Studio generations and render them directly in the widget. Returns generations with {id, type, status, model, params, results}. Use show_marketing_studio_generations for Marketing Studio video/image/ad history. Use this tool when the user explicitly asks to browse regular history/results; do not call it repeatedly as a post-generation poll step. Pass a prior generation's id as value in the medias array of a new generation to reuse it. To re-display a specific result, call job_display with its id (one id per call). Paginated: if next_cursor is not null, pass it as cursor to get the next page.

cursor.description: Pass next_cursor from previous response to get next page
